item.title: The AI Toolkit for Research Institutions: Five Tools for 2026
item.description: The AI toolkit for research institutions in 2026 has five tools, not one. Each tool does a distinct job. NotebookLM combines your own documents into one summary. Claude writes text and creates visual outputs. ChatGPT gives broad task coverage and flexible integrations. Gemini does autonomous web research and creates visuals from data. Napkin.ai turns paragraphs into diagrams. Together, these tools cover the full knowledge work cycle from intake to output, and you do not need coding skills to use them.
